title: The Necklace
synopsis: A story about a beautiful woman who believes she deserves better.

fullText.simplified:
徐来和贾聪回家以后开始计算，怎么才能凑到这笔钱。
    公寓卖掉，车卖掉。当然，还有那套带给她无限希望的晚礼服，也要卖掉。但即使这些东西全都卖掉，也只够买半条项链。买房子的时候他们已经花完了徐来父母、贾聪父母这两个家庭所有的钱，不可能再跟他们借钱了。如果去银行贷款，房子又卖掉了，银行不可能让他们贷款的。看来，他们只能在网上借高利息的贷款了。
    就这样，三个月后，他们终于凑够了钱，去珠宝店买回了那条钻石项链。
　贾聪把项链还给甄美的时候，甄美还是那么大气从容，连打开看一眼都没有，就把项链放回了衣帽间的柜子里。
　公寓没了，车没了，还有一大笔债要还。徐来和贾聪已经没有钱租大房子了，他们甚至连小公寓都租不起，只好和别人合租了一套小公寓。
    贾聪终于开始感受到穷人的生活了，那些她以前鄙视的穷人的生活。但她已经下定决心，这一次，她要为自己的行为买单。那些可怕的债她一定得和徐来一起还清。从前，徐来赚钱养家，让她能貌美如花；现在，她要出去赚钱，和徐来一起还清这笔天债。
    于是，她开始出去找工作，并在一家小公司找到了工作。
    贾聪变了！她不再每天只想着美容和购物了。从前她只记得高级商场的促销活动，现在她能记清所有超市的促销信息。而至于从前那些需要花钱的爱好：买包、买鞋、做美容，她都戒了。她仿佛一夜就变成了以前自己鄙视的那种普通人，那种不优雅、卑微、计较小钱的普通人。
    徐来也变了！为了帮妻子还债，他戒了烟，也戒了酒。他每天努力工作、加班。除了原本的工作，他还会在下班以后开出租车赚钱，只为了能多还一笔债。
    就这样，他们日日夜夜地赚钱，无穷无尽地还债……这样的生活过了整整八年。
fullText.traditional:
徐来和賈聰回家以後開始計算，怎麼才能湊到這筆錢。
    公寓賣掉，車賣掉。當然，還有那套帶給她無限希望的晚禮服，也要賣掉。但即使這些東西全都賣掉，也只夠買半條項鏈。買房子的時候他們已經花完了徐来父母、賈聰父母這兩個家庭所有的錢，不可能再跟他們借錢了。如果去銀行貸款，房子又賣掉了，銀行不可能讓他們貸款的。看來，他們只能在網上借高利息的貸款了。
    就這樣，三個月後，他們終於湊夠了錢，去珠寶店買回了那條鑽石項鏈。
　賈聰把項鏈還給甄美的時候，甄美還是那麼大氣從容，連打開看一眼都沒有，就把項鏈放回了衣帽間的櫃子裡。
　公寓沒了，車沒了，還有一大筆債要還。徐来和賈聰已經沒有錢租大房子了，他們甚至連小公寓都租不起，只好和別人合租了一套小公寓。
    賈聰終於開始感受到窮人的生活了，那些她以前鄙視的窮人的生活。但她已經下定決心，這一次，她要為自己的行為買單。那些可怕的債她一定得和徐来一起還清。從前，徐来賺錢養家，讓她能貌美如花；現在，她要出去賺錢，和徐来一起還清這筆天債。
    於是，她開始出去找工作，並在一家小公司找到了工作。
    賈聰變了！她不再每天只想著美容和購物了。從前她只記得高級商場的促銷活動，現在她能記清所有超市的促銷信息。而至於從前那些需要花錢的愛好：買包、買鞋、做美容，她都戒了。她彷彿一夜就變成了以前自己鄙視的那種普通人，那種不優雅、卑微、計較小錢的普通人。
    徐来也變了！為了幫妻子還債，他戒了煙，也戒了酒。他每天努力工作、加班。除了原本的工作，他還會在下班以後開出租車賺錢，只為了能多還一筆債。
    就這樣，他們日日夜夜地賺錢，無窮無盡地還債……這樣的生活過了整整八年。

sentences.traditional: 公寓賣掉，車賣掉。

sentences.simplified: 当然，还有那套带给她无限希望的晚礼服，也要卖掉。
sentences.traditional: 當然，還有那套帶給她無限希望的晚禮服，也要賣掉。

sentences.english: Of course, the evening gown that gave her limitless hope would also have to be sold.

sentences.simplified: 但即使这些东西全都卖掉，也只够买半条项链。
sentences.traditional: 但即使這些東西全都賣掉，也只夠買半條項鏈。

sentences.english: But even if they sold all these things, they would only have enough to buy half the necklace.

sentences.traditional: 買房子的時候他們已經花完了徐来父母、賈聰父母這兩個家庭所有的錢，

sentences.english: When they bought their home they had already spent all of the money from Xu Lai’s parents and Jia Cong’s parents.

sentences.simplified: 不可能再跟他们借钱了。
sentences.traditional: 不可能再跟他們借錢了。
sentences.pinyin: bù kě néng zài gēn tā men jiè qián le

sentences.simplified: 如果去银行贷款，
sentences.traditional: 如果去銀行貸款，

sentences.english: If they wanted to take out a loan from the bank, ..

sentences.simplified: 房子又卖掉了，银行不可能让他们贷款的。
sentences.traditional: 房子又賣掉了，銀行不可能讓他們貸款的。

sentences.english: .. they had already sold their home, so there was no way the bank would approve their loan.

sentences.simplified: 看来，他们只能在网上借高利息的贷款了。
sentences.traditional: 看來，他們只能在網上借高利息的貸款了。
sentences.pinyin: kàn lái tā men zhǐ néng zài wǎng shang jiè gāo lì xī de dài kuǎn le
sentences.english: It seems that their only option was to take out a high interest loan online.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，三个月后，他们终于凑够了钱，去珠宝店买回了那条钻石项链。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，三個月後，他們終於湊夠了錢，去珠寶店買回了那條鑽石項鏈。

sentences.english: Just like that, after three months, they raised enough money and went to the jewelry store to buy that diamond necklace.

sentences.english: When Jia Cong returned the necklace to Zhen Mei, Zhen Mei was very poised and calm.

sentences.simplified: 连打开看一眼都没有，就把项链放回了衣帽间的柜子里。
sentences.traditional: 連打開看一眼都沒有，就把項鏈放回了衣帽間的櫃子裡。

sentences.english: Without even opening it to take a look, she put the necklace back in the cabinet inside of the closet.

sentences.simplified: 公寓没了，车没了，还有一大笔债要还。
sentences.traditional: 公寓沒了，車沒了，還有一大筆債要還。

sentences.simplified: 徐来和贾聪已经没有钱租大房子了，
sentences.traditional: 徐来和賈聰已經沒有錢租大房子了，
sentences.pinyin: xú lái hé jiǎ cōng yǐ jīng méi yǒu qián zū dà fáng zi le

sentences.traditional: 他們甚至連小公寓都租不起，只好和別人合租了一套小公寓。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shèn zhì lián xiǎo gōng yù dōu zū bù qǐ zhǐ hǎo hé bié ren hé zū le yí tào xiǎo gōng yù
sentences.english: They couldn’t even afford to rent a small apartment, and had to rent a shared apartment with other people.

sentences.traditional: 賈聰終於開始感受到窮人的生活了，那些她以前鄙視的窮人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎ cōng zhōng yú kāi shǐ gǎn shòu dào qióng rén de shēng huó le nà xiē tā yǐ qián bǐ shì de qióng rén de shēng huó

sentences.simplified: 但她已经下定决心，这一次，她要为自己的行为买单。
sentences.traditional: 但她已經下定決心，這一次，她要為自己的行為買單。

sentences.english: But, she made up her mind. This time, she would take responsibility for her actions.

sentences.simplified: 那些可怕的债她一定得和徐来一起还清。
sentences.traditional: 那些可怕的債她一定得和徐来一起還清。
sentences.pinyin: nà xiē kě pà de zhài tā yí dìng děi hé xú lái yì qǐ huán qīng
sentences.english: She would definitely pay off that terrible debt together with Xu Lai.

sentences.simplified: 从前，徐来赚钱养家，让她能貌美如花；
sentences.traditional: 從前，徐来賺錢養家，讓她能貌美如花；
sentences.pinyin: cóng qián xú lái zhuàn qián yǎng jiā ràng tā néng mào měi rú huā
sentences.english: Previously, Xu Lai would work to support the family so she could sit there and look pretty.

sentences.simplified: 现在，她要出去赚钱，和徐来一起还清这笔天债。
sentences.traditional: 現在，她要出去賺錢，和徐来一起還清這筆天債。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā yào chū qù zhuàn qián hé xú lái yì qǐ huán qīng zhè bǐ tiān zhài
sentences.english: But now, she was going to earn money and pay off this sky-high debt together with Xu Lai.

sentences.simplified: 于是，她开始出去找工作，并在一家小公司找到了工作。
sentences.traditional: 於是，她開始出去找工作，並在一家小公司找到了工作。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā kāi shǐ chū qù zhǎo gōng zuò bìng zài yì jiā xiǎo gōng sī zhǎo dào le gōng zuò
sentences.english: So, she began to look for a job, and found one at a small company.

sentences.simplified: 贾聪变了！她不再每天只想着美容和购物了。
sentences.traditional: 賈聰變了！她不再每天只想著美容和購物了。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎ cōng biàn le tā bú zài měi tiān zhǐ xiǎng zhe měi róng hé gòu wù le
sentences.english: Jia Cong had changed! She no longer only thought about beauty treatment and shopping all day.

sentences.simplified: 从前她只记得高级商场的促销活动，
sentences.traditional: 從前她只記得高級商場的促銷活動，
sentences.pinyin: cóng qián tā zhǐ jì de gāo jí shāng chǎng de cù xiāo huó dòng
sentences.english: Previously, she only remembered the sales promotions at high-end shopping malls.

sentences.simplified: 现在她能记清所有超市的促销信息。
sentences.traditional: 現在她能記清所有超市的促銷信息。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā néng jì qīng suǒ yǒu chāo shì de cù xiāo xìn xī
sentences.english: Now, she could remember information about sales promotions at all of the supermarkets.

sentences.simplified: 而至于从前那些需要花钱的爱好：买包、买鞋、做美容，她都戒了。
sentences.traditional: 而至於從前那些需要花錢的愛好：買包、買鞋、做美容，她都戒了。
sentences.pinyin: ér zhì yú cóng qián nà xiē xū yào huā qián de ài hào mǎi bāo mǎi xié zuò měi róng tā dōu jiè le
sentences.english: And as for the expensive hobbies she once had: buying handbags, buying shoes, beauty treatment; she quit all of them.

sentences.simplified: 她仿佛一夜就变成了以前自己鄙视的那种普通人，
sentences.traditional: 她彷彿一夜就變成了以前自己鄙視的那種普通人，
sentences.pinyin: tā fǎng fú yí yè jiù biàn chéng le yǐ qián zì jǐ bǐ shì de nà zhǒng pǔ tōng rén
sentences.english: It was like overnight had she turned into the type of ordinary person she used to look down upon.

sentences.simplified: 那种不优雅、卑微、计较小钱的普通人。
sentences.traditional: 那種不優雅、卑微、計較小錢的普通人。
sentences.pinyin: nà zhǒng bù yōu yǎ bēi wēi jì jiào xiǎo qián de pǔ tōng rén
sentences.english: That sort of ordinary person who was unsophisticated, lowly, and penny-pinching.

sentences.simplified: 徐来也变了！为了帮妻子还债，他戒了烟，也戒了酒。
sentences.traditional: 徐来也變了！為了幫妻子還債，他戒了煙，也戒了酒。
sentences.pinyin: xú lái yě biàn le wèi le bāng qī zi huán zhài tā jiè le yān yě jiè le jiǔ
sentences.english: Xu Lai had also changed! In order to help his wife pay off the debt, he quit smoking and drinking.

sentences.simplified: 他每天努力工作、加班。
sentences.traditional: 他每天努力工作、加班。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān nǔ lì gōng zuò jiā bān
sentences.english: He worked hard every day, and worked overtime.

sentences.simplified: 除了原本的工作，他还会在下班以后开出租车赚钱，只为了能多还一笔债。
sentences.traditional: 除了原本的工作，他還會在下班以後開出租車賺錢，只為了能多還一筆債。
sentences.pinyin: chú le yuán běn de gōng zuò tā hái huì zài xià bān yǐ hòu kāi chū zū chē zhuàn qián zhǐ wèi le néng duō huán yì bǐ zhài
sentences.english: Aside from his original job, after he got off work he would drive a taxi to earn money so he could pay off more debt.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，他们日日夜夜地赚钱，无穷无尽地还债……
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，他們日日夜夜地賺錢，無窮無盡地還債……
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng tā men rì rì yè yè de zhuàn qián wú qióng wú jìn de huán zhài
sentences.english: Just like this, they worked to earn money day and night, endlessly paying off debt …

sentences.simplified: 这样的生活过了整整八年。
sentences.traditional: 這樣的生活過了整整八年。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de shēng huó guò le zhěng zhěng bā nián
sentences.english: They lived this life for a full eight years.

sentence_translations: When Xu Lai and Jia Cong got home they started to plan for just how they would raise this sum of money.
Sell the apartment, sell the car.
Of course, the evening gown that gave her limitless hope would also have to be sold.
But even if they sold all these things, they would only have enough to buy half the necklace.
When they bought their home they had already spent all of the money from Xu Lai’s parents and Jia Cong’s parents.
There was no way they could borrow money from them again.
If they wanted to take out a loan from the bank, ..
.. they had already sold their home, so there was no way the bank would approve their loan.
It seems that their only option was to take out a high interest loan online.
Just like that, after three months, they raised enough money and went to the jewelry store to buy that diamond necklace.
When Jia Cong returned the necklace to Zhen Mei, Zhen Mei was very poised and calm.
Without even opening it to take a look, she put the necklace back in the cabinet inside of the closet.
The apartment was gone, the car was gone, and there was a large debt to be repaid.
Xu Lai and Jia Cong no longer had the money to rent a large home.
They couldn’t even afford to rent a small apartment, and had to rent a shared apartment with other people.
Jia Cong finally began to experience the lifestyle of poor people, the very lifestyle that she used to look down on.
But, she made up her mind. This time, she would take responsibility for her actions.
She would definitely pay off that terrible debt together with Xu Lai.
Previously, Xu Lai would work to support the family so she could sit there and look pretty.
But now, she was going to earn money and pay off this sky-high debt together with Xu Lai.
So, she began to look for a job, and found one at a small company.
Jia Cong had changed! She no longer only thought about beauty treatment and shopping all day.
Previously, she only remembered the sales promotions at high-end shopping malls.
Now, she could remember information about sales promotions at all of the supermarkets.
And as for the expensive hobbies she once had: buying handbags, buying shoes, beauty treatment; she quit all of them.
It was like overnight had she turned into the type of ordinary person she used to look down upon.
That sort of ordinary person who was unsophisticated, lowly, and penny-pinching.
Xu Lai had also changed! In order to help his wife pay off the debt, he quit smoking and drinking.
He worked hard every day, and worked overtime.
Aside from his original job, after he got off work he would drive a taxi to earn money so he could pay off more debt.
Just like this, they worked to earn money day and night, endlessly paying off debt …
They lived this life for a full eight years.
